hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); if echo "$f" | grep -q '\.claude/agents/'; then git -C /workspaces/my-travel-assistant add "$f" && git -C /workspaces/my-travel-assistant diff --cached --quiet || (git -C /workspaces/my-travel-assistant commit -m 'chore: update Claude Code agent definitions' && git -C /workspaces/my-travel-assistant push origin main); fi 2>/dev/null || true
